findings.description: Enter key in AIInputMethodService calls `currentInputConnection?.commitText("\n", 1)` (line 212), injecting a literal newline. FloatingKeyboardOverlay (line 450) and KeyboardActivity (line 209) both call `service.pressEnter()` which first tries ACTION_IME_ENTER (triggering search/send/go on single-line fields) and only falls back to newline. The IME path won't submit forms/searches on single-line fields.

AIInputMethodService lacks user-adjustable font size (A+/A- buttons and KeyboardFontSizeStore integration) that FloatingKeyboardOverlay has (lines 244-262 in FloatingKeyboardOverlay.kt). The user intent explicitly requested font size to be user-adjustable. Since AIInputMethodService is a registered IME users can switch to, it should offer the same customization.

VoiceBridgeServer generates a per-instance authToken (line 46) but this token is never exposed to any client. The server is started in ControllerAccessibilityService.onServiceConnected() (line 174-177) but the token is not logged, stored, or shared. If this endpoint is intended for local testing/debugging, there's no way for a legitimate client to authenticate. If it's only for internal future use, this is acceptable but should be documented.

REV=3 migration (lines 70-78) discards ALL user-customized button mappings from legacy profiles (rev < 3), keeping only tuning values (sensitivity/deadzone/cursor/invert). This is a breaking data-loss change for existing users. User acknowledged as acceptable for AntiMicroX parity in prior review, but should be explicitly documented in release notes.

nudgePosition() clamps using `view.width` and `view.height` (lines 191-192) which are 0 before the first layout pass. If a controller sends stick/hat motion while dragging=true immediately after show() but before layout completes, the keyboard could be clamped to (0,0) or behave unexpectedly. The view is added in show() but layout is asynchronous.

styleLabel() logic is duplicated in FloatingKeyboardOverlay (line 309), AIInputMethodService (line 104), and KeyboardActivity has modeLabel() (line 88) with identical implementations. commitStyledChar() per-character styling logic is also triplicated across all three keyboards. This violates DRY and creates maintenance risk when style behavior changes.

VoiceBridgeServer is instantiated and started in onServiceConnected() (lines 174-177), contrary to prior finding F5 which claimed it wasn't started. The prior finding was incorrect — the code exists and is reachable.

testing_summary: Code compiles successfully (./gradlew compileDebugKotlin). No tests exist in this port yet per AGENTS.md. Manual verification of all user-intent fixes: text accumulation (typingTarget.refresh), D-pad/hat input, RS/Enter (ProfileSerializer rev3 + pressEnter), voice dictation append (injectText refresh+append), drag-to-reposition (handleGenericMotion + nudgePosition clamp), font size adjustment (KeyboardFontSizeStore + A+/A-), style labels (styleLabel rendered names), no emoji picker (skin tone picker only, which is different).
risk_rationale: Core user-intent bugs are fixed (text overwriting, D-pad not working, Enter not working, voice overwrite, drag off-screen). Remaining issues are: (1) AIInputMethodService Enter key behavior differs from other keyboards (auto-fixable), (2) font size not adjustable in IME (needs user decision), (3) VoiceBridgeServer auth token inaccessible (needs user decision on purpose), (4) ProfileSerializer rev3 migration is breaking but user-accepted, (5) potential race in nudgePosition clamping (auto-fixable), (6) code duplication across three keyboards (maintenance risk).
